text:
Alex W: quick idea from usability lab — stream UI feels heavy with a big stop. what if we surface a compact inline control that is less attention-grabbing but still obvious when you need it?
Maya P: yep, the team asked for verb-first labels too. prefer Interrupt / Retry / Discard instead of Stop. can we keep the main affordance subtle and put full labels on hover?
Samir: feasible. runtime already supports early-stop. resume is tricky (we'd regen with partial text as context until kernel support). we'll add payload flags to help the frontend: `stream_state`, `partial_token_count`, `remaining_tokens_estimate`.
Priya (design): visual treatment: 3 icon-only micro-buttons (16px) that expand to label on hover/focus. default collapsed shows a 1px separator so it doesn't read as a toolbar. for touch, they expand to 32px tappable area.
Jordan: also propose a tiny token-rate sparkline next to the token counter while streaming — low-contrast, shows tokens/sec so users can see burstiness.
Maya P: accessibility notes: alt text for sparkline ("Token rate: X tokens per second"), ensure high-contrast mode, and announce major state changes via `aria-live` polite. Avoid purely color-based cues.
a11y-bot: checklist: 1) icons have aria-label; 2) expand-to-label is keyboard-focusable; 3) `prefers-reduced-motion` disables all fades/pulses; 4) color contrast >= 4.5:1 for interactive icons.
Alex W: microcopy: primary action label = "Interrupt generation" (tooltip: "Stop generation and keep current text"). secondary = "Retry from here" (tooltip: "Retry preserving edits"). tertiary = "Discard draft" (shows toast undo x3s).
Maya P: run a 5-minute microcopy rapid test with engineers — prefer verbs and short tooltips. Also ensure translations read well for verb-first structure.
Samir: dev note: introduce featureflag `playground_compact_stream_v1`. new stream event fields: `stream_state: active|interrupted|discarded|finished`, `remaining_tokens_estimate` int (optional), `chunk_hint: true|false`, `chunk_seq` int. frontend will render boundary hint dots only when `chunk_hint` true.
Priya (design): chunk hint style: 2px left-edge fade-in dot that lasts ~120ms, name it "chunk hint" in spec. reduced-motion -> no fade, instant appear.
Jordan: token counter compact mode: show "used / ~est" (e.g. "40 / ~180"). hover expands to exact counts + sparkline. keep it visually muted so it doesn't steal attention from content.
Maya P: keyboard shortcuts: default Esc -> Interrupt in playground (configurable). document in help overlay and onboarding. ensure Esc doesn't conflict with embedded editors; make it scoped to playground iframe.
a11y-bot: also recommend announcing "Generation interrupted" via aria-live when user interrupts, and provide focus management to the partial output region.
Samir: will implement payload changes behind the flag and client hotkey mapping (user prefs). hooking sparkline to chunk timing is cheap. we'll compute tokens/sec client-side.
Alex W: prompt library tweak: add a collapsible Prompt Dock under the composer that shows up to 3 pinned prompts and quick-insert buttons. auto-collapse while streaming unless user pins it.
Priya (design): animate dock collapse gently (no animation for reduced-motion). pinned state must be visibly labelled and keyboard-accessible.
Maya P: also add a small inline "Retry with edit" affordance under partial outputs that opens a mini-editor prefilled with partial text. microcopy: "Retry with edits".
Jordan: next steps: Priya to push frames to Figma, Maya runs microcopy panel, Samir wires feature flag + payload, a11y-bot to run pass. target sandbox rollout next week.
